title: Decision
description: One decisions.jsonl line. Accepts the two DontPanic line shapes already on disk — {id,date,question,answer,status} and {id,ts,by,title,body} — without requiring a mass rewrite. id matches ^D\d{3}$. A line needs date or ts, and question or title. When status is present it is open|resolved|deferred.

date.description: Calendar date used by the current question/answer convention.

ts.description: Timestamp used by the legacy title/body convention.

rationale.description: Optional supporting rationale on the current convention.

allOf.description: A line carries date or ts (or both).
A line carries question or title (or both).
